title: Revision history
text:
Revision history

Summary of the change history for the 
Touchstone
 Exposure Data Validation
 Reference

 since its initial release.

| Validation reference version | Touchstone version | Date | Revision description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 8.0 | 2025 | Summer 2025 | Updated peril options, construction and occupancy codes, and secondary risk
 characteristics topics to reflect support for the new Verisk Inland Flood Model for Malaysia and Indonesia . |
| 7.0 | 2025 | June 2025 | Updated peril options and codes for Verisk Earthquake Model for Mexico , Verisk Typhoon Model for South Korea , Verisk Inland Flood Model for the UK and the Republic of Ireland , Verisk Severe Thunderstorm Model for the United States , and Verisk Bushfire Model for Australia . Added support for secondary risk characteristics (model-dependent), additional
 construction codes (including marine), and additional occupancy codes (including
 large industrial facilities and marine storage) to the updated models. Updated defensible space content for wildfires outside the United States. |
| 6.0 | 2024 | June 2024 | Added Backwater Valve Protection field to "Location building details" (only
 for Verisk Inland Flood Model for Canada . Added new smoke peril (SM) for the Verisk Wildfire Model for the United States and support for additional SRCs for the fire peril, such as skylights. |
| 5.1 | 2023
 (11.5) | February 2024 | Added "IT IF" to "Location building details" (Floor of Interest, First Floor
 Height), "Location connection detail fields" (Foundation Type), and "Location
 surrounding detail fields" (Custom Elevation and Custom Flood SOP). For the "-1"
 option, added several models. In "Europe perils", added "PFL" to Italy and
 "Inland Flood" to Perils for Italy. Touchstone now correctly imports
 exposure data with the Authorized (A) contract status. You can select and view
 it in the user interface. The imported data produces loss appropriately, both in
 isolation and in combination with other non-âAâ contracts in a set. Updated "Financial terms" section with NGM terms. |
| 5.0 | 2023 (11.0) | June
 2023 | Updated "-1" option in Floor of Interest. Added Verisk BINS IDs to Locations section. Added
 topics for Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, and United Arab Emirates (UAE) codes,
 which will be supported in the Verisk Earthquake Model for the Middle East in Touchstone in 2024. Updated codes for
 Jordan, Lebanon, and Saudi Arabia. Updated "Layers" topic with Next Generation Models (NGM) financial terms, such as the Aggregate
 Limit field and the Aggregate Attachment Point field. |
| 4.1 | 2022 (9.0) and 2022 (10.0) | November 2022 | Updated codes 486 and 487 in "Japan occupancy class codes". Fixed descriptions
 in "Industrial facility occupancy codes". Changed "Warehouse" to "Inland Transit
 Cargo" for code 366 in two topics. Added support for "US IF" to Wet Floodproofing
 and FIRM Compliance fields. Changed "Gumma" to "Gunma" in Japan prefecture codes.
 Added note in various places that Touchstone does not support single-day contracts. |
| 4.0 | 2022 (10.0) | June 2022 | Updated -1 option in Floor of Interest. For the Verisk Severe Thunderstorm Model for the United States , expanded support for combinations of
 construction/occupancy codes for consistency with the Verisk Hurricane Model for the United States . Updated occupancy code 374
 (greenhouses), construction codes 239 and 240 (wind turbines), and the 2000-series
 construction codes to support Verisk Severe Thunderstorm Model for the United States . The model
 also supports additional secondary risk characteristics: Gross Area and Certified
 Structures (IBHS) for wind; Roof Geometry, Roof Deck, Wall Attached Structure, and
 Gross Area for hail. |
| 3.1 | 2020 (8.x) and 2021 (9.1) and later | October 2021 | In "Location Building Detail Fields", updated "Wet FloodProofing" and "FIRM
 Compliance" fields to reflect support for US HU peril. |
| 3.0 | 2021 (9.x) and later | June 2021 | To support new marine cargo construction and occupancy codes: Added "Location
 Marine Fields", "Construction Class Codes â 2000-series", and "Marine Cargo
 Occupancy Codes"; updated "Marine Cargo Construction Codes", "United States and
 Canada Construction Class Codes", "Japan Construction Class Codes", and "Caribbean
 Construction Class Codes". In "United States Perils", added support in Verisk Severe Thunderstorm Model for the United States for new peril codes: hail, tornado, and
 straight line wind. Verisk has retired non-catastrophe loss
 analyses in Touchstone 9.0. Added note
 to various topics indicating that non-cat fields in the user interface do not
 affect losses. |
| 2.2 | 8.x and later | June 2021 | Updated "Building Condition" field information in "Location Building Detail
 Fields". Updated Japan construction code 247 in "Equipment Construction Codes".
 Added "PWB" to "Australia Perils". |
| 2.0 | 8.0 | July 2020 | Added 306 occupancy code (apartment/condos) to Certified Structures (IBHS)
 secondary modifiers. Added construction code 141, valid only for countries within the Caribbean
 region. Updated administrative and postal data for the Caribbean countries: Updated information in Location Building
 Details Fields for FIRM Compliance, Service Equipment Protection, and Wet
 Floodproofing. Updated Custom Flood Zone in Location
 Surrounding Detail Fields . Updated Peril
 Options , Peril Support by
 Country/Region , and CRESTA and Area Codes to fix errors and
 add new content related to Caribbean updates. Corrected information about importing offshore deductible terms: Deductible
 Physical Damage, Deductible Removal of Debris, Deductible Operator's Extra
 Expense, and Deductible Business Interruption. |
| 1.9.10 | 7.x and later | December 2019 | Updated Custom Elevation field in Location
 Surrounding Detail Fields to reflect support for Verisk Extratropical Cyclone Model for Europe and Verisk Inland Flood Model for Central Europe l Europe. Updated Custom Flood SOP Type field to note use of "H" (Height in meters) and
 "RP" (Return Period) codes. Updated Floor of Interest field in Location Building Detail
 Fields to reflect incorporation of the Verisk Coastal Flood Model for Great Britain into the Verisk Extratropical Cyclone Model for Europe , where the integrated model includes the storm
 surge events for the United Kingdom. Updated various location fields to reflect support for Verisk Earthquake Model for New Zealand in Location
 Surrounding Detail Fields , Location Building Detail
 Fields , Location Wall Detail Fields , and Location Roof Detail
 Fields . Updated Peril Options to include Liquefaction (PLQ) support. Updated New Zealand
 Perils to reflect support for additional perils. Updated Miscellaneous
 Occupancies to reflect support for Forestry in all of Europe. |
| 1.9.95 | 6.x and later | December 2019 | Updated Custom Flood Standard of Protection fields in Location
 Surrounding Detail Fields to reflect height of the system in meters.
 Updated First Floor Height field in field in Location Building Detail
 Fields to reflect height in meters. |
| 1.9.9 | 7.x and later | June 2019 | Updated construction/occupancy codes for new and updated models. |
| 1.9.8 | 5.x and later | June 2019 | Updated Foundation Type field. |
| 1.9.7 | 7.x and later | June 2019 | Added information about Custom Flood SOP Type to Location
 Surrounding Detail Fields for Verisk Inland Flood Model for Central Europe . |
| 1.9.6 | 6.x and later | December 2019 | Updated codes 156-159 in Steel Construction to reflect support in U.S. and Canada (varies by
 peril.) |
| 1.9.5 | 6.x and later | April 2019 | Added note to Mobile Home
 Construction indicating that Detailed Loss Analysis results will not
 match between Touchstone 6.0 and Touchstone 7.0 for the Verisk Hurricane Model for the United States . Updated information about slot count and slot drill values. |
| 1.9.4 | 6.x and later | February 2019 | Updated various topics to indicate that construction code 250 is not valid for
 any peril in the United States. |
| 1.9.3 | 6.x and later | February 2019 | Updated Location Surrounding Detail Fields with information about Defensible Space and Firewise Community
 Participation secondary risk characteristics (SRC). |
| 1.9.2 | 6.x and later | January 2019 | Updated China
 Construction Class Codes and China Occupancy Class
 Codes with codes for the updated Verisk Typhoon Model for Mainland China .
 Updated support information related to the updated model in Miscellaneous Occupancies , Bridge Construction , Pipeline Construction , Steel Construction , Storage Tank
 Construction , and Tunnel
 Construction . |
| 1.9.1 | 4.x and later | November 2018 | Updated Floor of Interest field in Location Building Detail
 Fields with -1 Basement support for Verisk Hurricane Model for the United States . Updated Location Group Name field in Location Contract
 Fields with note regarding use of exposure coding for campus (group)
 structures. |
| 1.9.0 | 4.x and later | August 2018 | Updated many topics with new codes (associated with new models or changes to
 current models) and corrected some errors. Removed mapping information; users can
 find that information in the model documentation. Added robust descriptions to Industrial Facility
 Occupancies topic. Updated SIC2-digit codes information as needed. |
| 1.8.0 | 4.x and later | June 2018 | Updated Location
 Builder Risk Fields to reflect No Builder's Risk (0) as the default for Project Phase Code . |
| 1.7.0 | 4.x and later | May 2018 | Updated Southeast Asia Occupancy Class Codes to reflect support for 400-series
 codes. |
| 1.6.0 | 5.x and later | August 2018 | Updated Location
 Basic Building Fields and Difference between
 Gross Area and Floor Area fields to reflect the effect of Gross
 Area on the Verisk Hurricane Model for the United States and the Verisk Earthquake Model for the United States . |
| 1.5.0 | 5.1 | January 2018 | Updated Pipeline
 Construction , Storage Tank Construction , and United States and
 Canada Construction Class Codes with recommendations about the recommended
 codes to use with the Verisk Earthquake Model for the United States . |

rows:
Updated peril options, construction and occupancy codes, and secondary risk
                    characteristics topics to reflect support for the new Verisk Inland Flood Model for Malaysia and Indonesia .

Updated peril options and codes for Verisk Earthquake Model for Mexico , Verisk Typhoon Model for South Korea , Verisk Inland Flood Model for the UK and the Republic of Ireland , Verisk Severe Thunderstorm Model for the United States , and Verisk Bushfire Model for Australia . Added support for secondary risk characteristics (model-dependent), additional
                    construction codes (including marine), and additional occupancy codes (including
                    large industrial facilities and marine storage) to the updated models. Updated defensible space content for wildfires outside the United States.

Added Backwater Valve Protection field to "Location building details" (only
                    for Verisk Inland Flood Model for Canada . Added new smoke peril (SM) for the Verisk Wildfire Model for the United States and support for additional SRCs for the fire peril, such as skylights.

Added "IT IF" to "Location building details" (Floor of Interest, First Floor
                    Height), "Location connection detail fields" (Foundation Type), and "Location
                    surrounding detail fields" (Custom Elevation and Custom Flood SOP). For the "-1"
                    option, added several models. In "Europe perils", added "PFL" to Italy and
                    "Inland Flood" to Perils for Italy. Touchstone now correctly imports
                    exposure data with the Authorized (A) contract status. You can select and view
                    it in the user interface. The imported data produces loss appropriately, both in
                    isolation and in combination with other non-âAâ contracts in a set. Updated "Financial terms" section with NGM terms.

Updated "-1" option in Floor of Interest. Added Verisk BINS IDs to Locations section. Added
                  topics for Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, and United Arab Emirates (UAE) codes,
                  which will be supported in the Verisk Earthquake Model for the Middle East in Touchstone in 2024. Updated codes for
                  Jordan, Lebanon, and Saudi Arabia. Updated "Layers" topic with Next Generation Models (NGM) financial terms, such as the Aggregate
                Limit field and the Aggregate Attachment Point field.

Updated codes 486 and 487 in "Japan occupancy class codes". Fixed descriptions
                in "Industrial facility occupancy codes". Changed "Warehouse" to "Inland Transit
                Cargo" for code 366 in two topics. Added support for "US IF" to Wet Floodproofing
                and FIRM Compliance fields. Changed "Gumma" to "Gunma" in Japan prefecture codes.
                Added note in various places that Touchstone does not support single-day contracts.

Updated -1 option in Floor of Interest. For the Verisk Severe Thunderstorm Model for the United States , expanded support for combinations of
                  construction/occupancy codes for consistency with the Verisk Hurricane Model for the United States . Updated occupancy code 374
                  (greenhouses), construction codes 239 and 240 (wind turbines), and the 2000-series
                  construction codes to support Verisk Severe Thunderstorm Model for the United States . The model
                  also supports additional secondary risk characteristics: Gross Area and Certified
                  Structures (IBHS) for wind; Roof Geometry, Roof Deck, Wall Attached Structure, and
                  Gross Area for hail.

In "Location Building Detail Fields", updated "Wet FloodProofing" and "FIRM
                Compliance" fields to reflect support for US HU peril.

To support new marine cargo construction and occupancy codes: Added "Location
                  Marine Fields", "Construction Class Codes â 2000-series", and "Marine Cargo
                  Occupancy Codes"; updated "Marine Cargo Construction Codes", "United States and
                  Canada Construction Class Codes", "Japan Construction Class Codes", and "Caribbean
                  Construction Class Codes". In "United States Perils", added support in Verisk Severe Thunderstorm Model for the United States for new peril codes: hail, tornado, and
                  straight line wind. Verisk has retired non-catastrophe loss
                  analyses in Touchstone 9.0. Added note
                  to various topics indicating that non-cat fields in the user interface do not
                  affect losses.

Updated "Building Condition" field information in "Location Building Detail
                Fields". Updated Japan construction code 247 in "Equipment Construction Codes".
                Added "PWB" to "Australia Perils".

Added 306 occupancy code (apartment/condos) to Certified Structures (IBHS)
                  secondary modifiers. Added construction code 141, valid only for countries within the Caribbean
                  region. Updated administrative and postal data for the Caribbean countries: Updated information in Location Building
                    Details Fields for FIRM Compliance, Service Equipment Protection, and Wet
                  Floodproofing. Updated Custom Flood Zone in Location
                    Surrounding Detail Fields . Updated Peril
                  Options , Peril Support by
                    Country/Region , and CRESTA and Area Codes to fix errors and
                  add new content related to Caribbean updates. Corrected information about importing offshore deductible terms: Deductible
                  Physical Damage, Deductible Removal of Debris, Deductible Operator's Extra
                  Expense, and Deductible Business Interruption.

Updated Custom Elevation field in Location
                    Surrounding Detail Fields to reflect support for Verisk Extratropical Cyclone Model for Europe and Verisk Inland Flood Model for Central Europe l Europe. Updated Custom Flood SOP Type field to note use of "H" (Height in meters) and
                  "RP" (Return Period) codes. Updated Floor of Interest field in Location Building Detail
                    Fields to reflect incorporation of the Verisk Coastal Flood Model for Great Britain into the Verisk Extratropical Cyclone Model for Europe , where the integrated model includes the storm
                  surge events for the United Kingdom. Updated various location fields to reflect support for Verisk Earthquake Model for New Zealand in Location
                    Surrounding Detail Fields , Location Building Detail
                    Fields , Location Wall Detail Fields , and Location Roof Detail
                    Fields . Updated Peril Options to include Liquefaction (PLQ) support. Updated New Zealand
                    Perils to reflect support for additional perils. Updated Miscellaneous
                    Occupancies to reflect support for Forestry in all of Europe.

Updated Custom Flood Standard of Protection fields in Location
                    Surrounding Detail Fields to reflect height of the system in meters.
                  Updated First Floor Height field in field in Location Building Detail
                    Fields to reflect height in meters.
Updated construction/occupancy codes for new and updated models.

Added information about Custom Flood SOP Type to Location
                  Surrounding Detail Fields for Verisk Inland Flood Model for Central Europe .

Updated codes 156-159 in Steel Construction to reflect support in U.S. and Canada (varies by
                peril.)

Added note to Mobile Home
                    Construction indicating that Detailed Loss Analysis results will not
                  match between Touchstone 6.0 and Touchstone 7.0 for the Verisk Hurricane Model for the United States . Updated information about slot count and slot drill values.

Updated various topics to indicate that construction code 250 is not valid for
                any peril in the United States.

Updated Location Surrounding Detail Fields with information about Defensible Space and Firewise Community
                  Participation secondary risk characteristics (SRC).

Updated China
                  Construction Class Codes and China Occupancy Class
                  Codes with codes for the updated Verisk Typhoon Model for Mainland China .
                Updated support information related to the updated model in Miscellaneous Occupancies , Bridge Construction , Pipeline Construction , Steel Construction , Storage Tank
                Construction , and Tunnel
                  Construction .

Updated Floor of Interest field in Location Building Detail
                  Fields with -1 Basement support for Verisk Hurricane Model for the United States . Updated Location Group Name field in Location Contract
                  Fields with note regarding use of exposure coding for campus (group)
                structures.

Updated many topics with new codes (associated with new models or changes to
                current models) and corrected some errors. Removed mapping information; users can
                find that information in the model documentation. Added robust descriptions to Industrial Facility
                  Occupancies topic. Updated SIC2-digit codes information as needed.

Updated Location
                  Builder Risk Fields to reflect No Builder's Risk (0) as the default for Project Phase Code .

Updated Southeast Asia Occupancy Class Codes to reflect support for 400-series
                codes.

Updated Location
                  Basic Building Fields and Difference between
                  Gross Area and Floor Area fields to reflect the effect of Gross
                  Area on the Verisk Hurricane Model for the United States and the Verisk Earthquake Model for the United States .

Updated Pipeline
                  Construction , Storage Tank Construction , and United States and
                  Canada Construction Class Codes with recommendations about the recommended
                codes to use with the Verisk Earthquake Model for the United States .
